## Essentials

The bare minimum needed to follow the workshop hands-on.

{{< include resources/essentials.qmd >}}

::: {.agents-disclaimer}
Note: Claude Code requires a paid subscription, so sign up for at least a [Claude Pro](https://claude.ai/login?plan=pro){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} account before the workshop. Netlify is free and needs nothing installed: just create the account ahead of time so you can publish your site during the workshop.
:::

### Installing Claude Code

Positron and Netlify are ordinary sign-up-and-download affairs. Claude Code is the one piece you install by typing a line, and you do it from inside Positron. Work through these five steps before the workshop so you arrive ready to build.

## Alternatives

Other agents and IDEs exist and are good options. You may wish to use one of these instead if you're more comfortable with them, or if you already have an account with an alternative agent provider (e.g., OpenAI, Google), though the specifics of how to use them may differ from what is covered in the workshop with Claude Code.
